purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software system. It handles CLAIM connection settings (CLAIM接続設定, screen P02X), allowing users to configure and register connection parameters such as address, port, and memo for system management records. It reads system management table (tbl_syskanri) records, presents them on a screen, validates input, and registers/transmits settings.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP (Message Control Program) database access layer (PERFORM 910-DBSELECT-SEC, 990-DBCLOSE-SEC)
Extensive use of COPY statements for copybooks (.INC files) in LINKAGE SECTION
Japanese text in comments (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake)
EVALUATE with ALSO for multi-condition dispatch on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern for inter-screen state management
REDEFINES used for combo-box table overlay
EXIT PROGRAM used for subprogram return
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments to appear as mojibake. The program is clearly a production subprogram within the ORCA open-source Japanese medical receipt system. It uses a proprietary MCP middleware layer rather than EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS for database access. The 'online-cics' program_type label is approximate — it is actually an event-driven screen program using the ORCA MCP framework, not CICS proper.
